rttMs.description: The round trip time in milliseconds

throughputKbps.description: The network throughput in kilobits per second

requestLatencyMs.description: The network request latency in milliseconds

downloadThroughputKbps.description: The network download throughput in kilobits per second

uploadThroughputKbps.description: The network upload throughput in kilobits per second

cpuSlowdownMultiplier.description: The amount of slowdown applied to the cpu (1/<cpuSlowdownMultiplier>)

title:
An object representing Lighthouse's Throttling settings.
Example:
     {
       "rttMs": 150,
       "throughputKbps": 1638.4,
       "requestLatencyMs": 562.5,
       "downloadThroughputKbps": 1474.5600000000002,
       "uploadThroughputKbps": 675,
       "cpuSlowdownMultiplier": 4
     }
name: LighthouseConfigSettingsThrottling
